Livestock Weighted Average Report for 10/24/2026 - Final

AUCTION
                                                          This Week                 Last Reported                      Last Year
                                                                                     10/17/2026
Total Receipts:                                            938                         904                           1,394
Feeder Cattle:                                             809(86.2%)                  770(85.2%)                    1,220(87.5%)
Slaughter Cattle:                                           67(7.1%)                    58(6.4%)                       105(7.5%)
Replacement Cattle:                                         62(6.6%)                    76(8.4%)                        69(4.9%)

Special Note: Baby Calf: 875.00-1000.00 Beef
Correction to remove entry showing slaughter cows at extremely low weight.

Compared to last Saturday: Feeder steers under 500 lbs sharply higher, over 500 lbs 3.00-5.00 higher, Feeder and yearling heifers steady to
5.00 higher,       Very good demand for lite weight steers and good demand for middle weight and yearling steers, Good demand for feeder
and yearling heifers, Slaughter cows and bulls 1.00-3.00 higher, Moderate demand for slaughter classes. Supply included: 86% Feeder Cattle
(37% Steers, 43% Heifers, 19% Bulls, 0% Beef/Dairy Steers); 7% Slaughter Cattle (5% Heifers, 82% Cows, 13% Bulls); 7% Replacement Cattle
(3% Stock Cows, 77% Bred Cows, 6% Bred Heifers, 10% Cow-Calf Pairs, 3% Bulls). Feeder cattle supply over 600 lbs was 50%.

Please Note:
The above USDA LPGMN price report is reflective of the majority of classes and grades of livestock offered for sale.
There may be instances where some sales do not fit within reporting guidelines and therefore will not be included in
the report. Prices are reported on an FOB basis, unless otherwise noted.

Explanatory Notes:
Stage (Cattle) - Represents pregnancy stage (O = open; T1 = 1st Trimester, 1 to 3 months; T1-2 = 1st/2nd trimester, 1
to 6 months; T2 = 2nd Trimester, 4 to 6 months; T2-3 = 2nd/3rd Trimester, 4 to 9 months; T3 = 3rd Trimester, 7 to 9
months; T1-3 = all trimesters, 1 to 9 months)

Age - Numerical representation of age in years.
